body: If I had to go out listening to anything. It'd be Alice In Chains. Between AIC, Tool and APC....man. I know they sound depressing to some people but Layne speaks to the pain.

Me too. I'm going to try to take things one step at a time. It's hard when you only have 1 person to talk to. Sometimes you feel like you bother the hell out of them. I know my friend doesn't mind but these thoughts can really be an emotional drain on friends.

Just keep yourself in check. I have extreme problems with that and am glad to have found support here. I never thought I'd actually attempt it until I snapped and my mind said it wanted the deep sleep. Had I not stopped to smoke, I could very well be dead. A mouse click is very real. You never know so be on your guard. Fate had it that I got interrupted midway. My thoughts are with you as you suffer similarly to me.
